cl.x: Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (May 2026, Version 01.03) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality / Pre-Treatment
s: Concrete

Surface must be clean and sound. Remove all deteriorated concrete, dirt, oil, grease, and other bond-inhibiting materials from the area to be repaired. Be sure repair area is not less than 5 mm deep. Preparation work should be done by appropriate mechanical techniques. Obtain an exposed aggregate surface with a minimum surface profile of 3 mm (CSP 6) on clean, sound concrete. To ensure optimum repair results, the effectiveness of decontamination and preparation should be assessed by a pull-off test. Saw cutting of edges is recommended. Saturate surface to be repaired with clean water. Substrate should be saturated surface dry (SSD) prior to application.
Steel reinforcement

Rust, scale, mortar, concrete, dust and other loose and deleterious material which reduces bond or contributes to corrosion shall be removed. Surfaces shall be prepared using abrasive blast cleaning techniques or high pressure water-blasting to achieve a bright metal finish.

cl.x: Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (May 2026, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Mixing
s: Water mix: Use the minimum amount of water necessary for ease of placement. The recommended water addition is 0.530–0.600 L per 5 kg bag.

Mixing sequence: Add 70 % of the required water into the mixing vessel, then gradually add LANKO® 136 Rapid Patching Mortar while mixing. Slowly incorporate the remaining water until the desired consistency is achieved.

Site condition adjustments: Mixing ratios may vary based on site conditions. For optimal performance, ensure both the mixing water and substrate are between 5 °C and 30 °C. Small trial batches are recommended to determine the best working consistency.
Mixing method: Use an electric drill with a paddle mixer or mix by hand. Mix for approximately 3 minutes to achieve the best results.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application
cl.x: Reinforcement Corrosion Protection / Primer Coating Where a reinforcement coating is required, apply to the whole exposed circumference of the steel the SikaTop-110 EpoCem or Sika Monotop-910N. The repair mortar must be applied into the coating ‘wet’ on ‘dry’.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application > Concrete Bonding Primer
cl.x: Prime the prepared substrate with a scrub coat of LANKO® 136 Rapid Patching Mortar by firmly scraping the scrub coat over the substrate surface to form a thin layer and fill any pores or cavities in the surface. Ensure the whole surface to be repaired is covered by the scrub coat. The repair mortar has to be applied into primer ‘wet’ on ‘wet’.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application > Repair Mortar
cl.x: The prepared mortar must be scrubbed into the substrate. Be sure to fill all pores and voids. force materials against the edge of the repair, working towards the centre. After filling the repair, screed of excess. Allow concrete to set to desired stiffness, then finish. If a smoother finish is desired, a magnesium float should be used. Mixing, placing and finishing should not exceed 15 minutes maximum. To control setting times, cold water should be used in hot weather and hot water used in cold weather.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Curing Treatment
cl.x: Moist cure should commence immediately after finishing. It is necessary to protect newly applied material from rain. To prevent from freezing, cover with insulating material.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: LANKO® 136 Rapid Patching Mortar should be removed from tools and equipment immediately after use with clean water. Any cured material may be removed by mechanical means.

s: Apply only to sound, prepared substrate.
Avoid application in direct sun and/or strong winds.
Do not feather edge.
Use only potable water.
Variations in aggregates may produce differences in strengths from the typical values stated in Product Data Sheet.
For early application of epoxy coatings, on site testing is recommended to verify suitability. Consult the coatings manufacturer for guidance.
